nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a field, $k$ a natural number, $S$ a finite set of monic irreducible polynomials of degree $k$ over $K$, and $H \ne 0$ a polynomial over $K$. Then Distinct monic irreducible polynomials are coprime, so the product of those dividing $H$ divides $H$, and its degree is $k$ times their number.
nodes.title: At most deg H / k irreducible factors of degree k

nodes.title: Monic irreducible polynomials of prime degree over Z/pZ

nodes.summary: For a prime $k$, the number of monic irreducible polynomials $x^k + a_{k-1} x^{k-1} + \dots + a_0 \in \mathbb{Z}_2[x]$ is $(2^k - 2)/k$. For example, $k = 2$ gives the single polynomial $x^2 + x + 1$ and $k = 3$ gives $x^3 + x + 1$ and $x^3 + x^2 + 1$; for $k = 31$ there are $(2^{31} - 2)/31 = 69273666$ moduli to choose from.
nodes.title: Monic irreducible polynomials of prime degree over Z2
